done-rust-edit.quantity: a one-line Rust edit's make done, against a fresh full baseline, each output line timestamped
done-rust-edit.subject: feature 444 T36's probe seven, rust/phases/src/driver/check.rs edited by one comment line
done-rust-edit.command: make done INCREMENTAL=0; sed -i 's|none on a sound map\.$|none on a sound map (probe).|' rust/phases/src/driver/check.rs; make done (each line timestamped from its start); git checkout -- rust/phases/src/driver/check.rs
done-rust-edit.method: the run's timestamps read phase by phase; its run record (dev/run-log/) for the phases' own seconds

hooks-bash.quantity: the guards that run before a Bash call: how many, the slowest, all of them summed
hooks-bash.subject: the PreToolUse hooks of .claude/settings.json and ~/.claude/settings.json whose matcher takes Bash
hooks-bash.command: each hook's command run with a sample PreToolUse JSON for a Bash `ls` on stdin, three times, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=/diagram
hooks-bash.method: the median of three runs a hook; the slowest and the sum of the medians

pair-hooks-suite.quantity: pair-hooks.sh's runs inside its own suite
pair-hooks-suite.subject: tests/hooks/test-pair-hooks.sh, its HOOK pointed at a wrapper that times each run
pair-hooks-suite.command: a scratch copy of the suite with HOOK set to a timing wrapper around scripts/hooks/pair-hooks.sh, run once
pair-hooks-suite.method: the wrapper's per-run times summed; 19 of the copy's 100 cases failed on its relocated fixture paths, so a close figure, not an exact one

suite-cpu.quantity: every test's own time, summed over the tree outside tests/tooling and over tests/tooling
suite-cpu.subject: the gate's test trees
suite-cpu.command: make durations FULL=1 N=20000; PYTEST_ADDOPTS="--durations=0" make test-file FILE=tests/tooling
suite-cpu.method: each call, setup and teardown row summed, per tree

rust-tests.subject: rust/phases
rust-tests.command: python3 scripts/gates/rust_checks.py test (cargo's own summary line read)

python-start.quantity: a Python interpreter's start with nothing to run
python-start.subject: python3 3.14 in the container

design-fixes.quantity: three of the day's speedups that changed what a tool does, not its language
design-fixes.subject: the claims gate test, the counters mutation test, a check bundle
design-fixes.command: cProfile of tests.tooling.test_claims_index's slowest test in process, before and after 39112f3ec; make test-file of tests/tooling/test_rust_tooling.py before and after 2b4238a6c; scripts/record/check_bundle.py 0086 --for record-format timed before and after d3ff0e16d
design-fixes.method: the test's or the command's own time, warm, before and after its commit
